acceptedBehavior: Opt-in checkpoint uses the same current process, report, immutable packet, exact endpoint and existing request budget. Default immediate cleanup path remains supported by the author actual-finalizer check and focused source review.

Financial cleanup, exact TEST endpoint disable/readback and both exact fixture archives are confirmed before waiting; financial/archive failures skip waiting, retain missing acceptance and attempt only same-resource cleanup.

Root acknowledgement must match exact phase/endpoint/verified canonical event and its accepted dedicated current-Checkout receipt,2xx,delivery time,digest and explicit delete confirmation. Foreign Checkout/legacy destination/wrong event/type cannot certify delivery.
The wait has one ten-minute deadline, max16 invalid inputs, input closure/failure handling and no retention of rejected values. An acknowledgement arriving exactly at the deadline is rejected.
After review the endpoint is freshly read; changed phase, mode, API version, URL or enabled status prevents deletion and phase closure.

EOF, timeout or missing review does not certify Workbench acceptance. Cleanup remains bounded and same-resource; an unknown DELETE or lost durable pre-DELETE save never triggers a blind second DELETE.

The successful checkpoint requires8 physical cleanup calls and fits30 spent+8=38/40;33 spent cannot exceed40 or reset the budget using acknowledgement. Retained cleanup remains allowed after phase expiry without another Checkout/subscription.
A failed initial checkpoint save closes the owned input source even before a timer exists. No input read or provider effect is needed for that failure cleanup.
